description: Admin Dashboard: Implement complete admin dashboard with authentication (Login page with JWT), protected routes, dashboard layout (sidebar navigation, header), and all management pages (Overview with stats and Chart.js graphs, Projects CRUD with image upload and drag-drop reorder, Blog CRUD with Markdown editor and live preview, Messages inbox with read/unread status, Analytics page with visit graphs, Profile/Settings with change password and theme toggle). This provides full admin functionality for content management.
steps: 1. Create client/src/components/ProtectedRoute.jsx HOC or wrapper component that checks isAuthenticated from useAuth hook, redirects to /login if not authenticated, otherwise renders children. This will wrap all dashboard routes.

2. Create client/src/pages/Dashboard/Login.jsx: glassmorphism design form with username and password fields, form validation (required fields), submit calls useAuth login function with POST /api/auth/login, on success redirect to /dashboard, on error display error message (invalid credentials, network errors). Test with default admin credentials from backend seed script.

3. Create client/src/pages/Dashboard/DashboardLayout.jsx: main layout component with client/src/pages/Dashboard/Sidebar.jsx (logo, nav links: Vue d'ensemble, Projets, Blog, Messages, Analytics, Profil, Paramètres, logout button, responsive: collapses to hamburger on mobile with slide-in) and client/src/pages/Dashboard/Header.jsx (breadcrumb trail, user profile dropdown with logout). Main content area renders child routes. Apply theme matching public portfolio.

4. Create client/src/pages/Dashboard/Overview.jsx: stats cards (total projects, total blog posts, unread messages, total page views - fetch from GET /api/projects, /api/blog, /api/messages?read=false, /api/analytics/dashboard), Chart.js graphs (line chart: visits per day last 30 days, bar chart: projects by category, doughnut chart: blog posts published vs drafts). Install chart.js and react-chartjs-2. Loading states, error handling, refresh button. Create client/src/components/dashboard/StatsCard.jsx reusable component.

5. Create client/src/pages/Dashboard/ProjectsManagement.jsx with client/src/components/dashboard/ProjectList.jsx (table/grid showing all projects with thumbnail, title, category, featured status, order, edit/delete actions) and client/src/components/dashboard/ProjectForm.jsx (modal form with fields: title, description, longDescription, technologies multi-input, category dropdown, imageUrl file upload with preview, liveUrl, githubUrl, featured checkbox, form validation). Implement image upload: file input sends multipart/form-data to POST /api/projects, backend uploads to Cloudinary returns URL. Implement drag & drop reordering using react-beautiful-dnd or @dnd-kit/core to reorder projects and update order field via PUT /api/projects/:id. Delete with confirmation modal. Install drag-drop library.

6. Create client/src/pages/Dashboard/BlogManagement.jsx with client/src/components/dashboard/BlogList.jsx (table showing all posts with title, status published/draft, date, tags, edit/delete actions) and client/src/components/dashboard/BlogForm.jsx (form with title, slug auto-generated editable, content Markdown editor with toolbar and live preview pane using react-markdown-editor-lite, excerpt, coverImage file upload, tags multi-input, category, published toggle). Live preview renders Markdown as HTML using react-markdown in split view. Install react-markdown-editor-lite and react-markdown. Save drafts as published=false. Delete with confirmation.

7. Create client/src/pages/Dashboard/MessagesInbox.jsx with client/src/components/dashboard/MessageRow.jsx: table showing all messages (name, email, message preview, date, read/unread status badge), filter tabs ('Tous', 'Non lus', 'Lus'), pagination (20 messages per page), mark as read button (PATCH /api/messages/:id/read toggles status, optimistic update), delete button with confirmation (DELETE /api/messages/:id), sort by date descending. Display unread count badge on sidebar 'Messages' link.

8. Create client/src/pages/Dashboard/Analytics.jsx with client/src/components/dashboard/AnalyticsChart.jsx: line chart for page views per day with date range selector (last 7, 30, 90 days, custom range using react-datepicker), bar chart for top 5 most visited pages, stats cards (total visits, total project clicks, total contact submits), pie chart for event types breakdown. Fetch from GET /api/analytics/dashboard with query params for date range. Optional: export to CSV button. Install react-datepicker if implementing date range picker.

9. Create client/src/pages/Dashboard/Profile.jsx: display user info (username, email, role from AuthContext user state), edit profile form (bio, photo, social links - extend User model in backend if implementing full edit). Create client/src/components/dashboard/ChangePasswordForm.jsx: form with old password, new password, confirm new password fields, validation (passwords match, old password correct), submit to POST /api/auth/change-password, success message on success, error on failure (wrong old password).

10. Create client/src/pages/Dashboard/Settings.jsx with theme toggle (dark/light mode switch storing preference in localStorage, applying CSS class to body using client/src/hooks/useTheme.js custom hook), general settings section (notifications preferences placeholder for future enhancements). Theme toggle updates body class and persists preference.

11. Update client/src/App.js with routing for dashboard: add react-router-dom routes (/ for Portfolio, /login for Login, /dashboard/* for DashboardLayout with nested routes for Overview, ProjectsManagement, BlogManagement, MessagesInbox, Analytics, Profile, Settings). Wrap dashboard routes in ProtectedRoute. Install react-router-dom if not already installed.

12. Enhance dashboard with optional features: implement polling for unread message badge (poll GET /api/messages?read=false every 30 seconds in DashboardLayout, update badge count on sidebar 'Messages' link), ensure all dashboard pages are fully responsive (sidebar hamburger mobile, tables become cards on mobile or horizontal scroll, forms stack vertically, charts adjust size). Test at 320px, 768px, 1024px widths.
acceptance_criteria: ProtectedRoute component redirects to /login when user not authenticated, allows access when authenticated

Login page displays with glassmorphism design, form validation works (required fields), submit with valid admin credentials (from backend seed script) logs in and redirects to /dashboard, invalid credentials display error message, JWT token stored in localStorage on success
Dashboard layout displays with sidebar (nav links, logout button), header (breadcrumb, user dropdown), main content area, sidebar collapses to hamburger on mobile with slide-in animation

Overview page displays stats cards with correct counts (fetch from APIs verified in Network tab), Chart.js graphs render with data (line chart visits, bar chart projects by category, doughnut chart published vs draft posts), refresh button reloads data

Projects management: list displays all projects with thumbnails and details, 'Add Project' opens form modal, form validates inputs (required fields, URL formats), image upload shows preview and submits file to API (verify in Network tab multipart/form-data POST /api/projects, verify image uploaded to Cloudinary), drag & drop reorder works (drag project, drop, verify order updates via PUT request), edit project updates data, delete with confirmation removes project

Blog management: list displays all posts with status badges, 'Add Post' opens form, Markdown editor displays with toolbar, live preview renders Markdown correctly (test bold, headings, lists), slug auto-generates from title, cover image upload works, tags multi-input works, published toggle works, drafts saved as published=false, edit/delete work

Messages inbox: displays all messages, filter tabs switch between all/unread/read, pagination works (if >20 messages), mark as read toggles status (verify PATCH request, UI updates immediately), delete with confirmation removes message (verify DELETE request), unread badge on sidebar displays correct count

Analytics page: line chart displays visits by day, date range selector changes data (verify GET request with date params), bar chart shows top pages, stats cards show totals, pie chart shows event breakdown, handles no data gracefully

Profile page: displays user info correctly, change password form validates (passwords match, old password required), submit with correct old password changes password (verify POST /api/auth/change-password), test by logging out and back in with new password, error displayed for wrong old password
Settings page: theme toggle switches between dark/light mode (verify body class changes, visual theme changes, preference persists in localStorage after refresh)

Routing works: / loads public portfolio, /login loads login page, /dashboard routes load dashboard layout with correct nested pages, protected routes redirect to /login when not authenticated, after login can access all dashboard pages
Dashboard fully responsive: test at 320px (mobile), 768px (tablet), 1024px (desktop), verify sidebar hamburger works on mobile, tables/forms/charts adapt to screen size, all pages usable on mobile
verification: Without logging in, navigate to /dashboard in browser, verify redirect to /login occurs

On /login page, submit empty form and verify validation errors, submit with invalid credentials (wrong username/password) and verify error message, submit with valid admin credentials (default from backend seed script: check server/scripts/createAdmin.js for credentials) and verify redirect to /dashboard, open DevTools Application tab → Local Storage and confirm JWT token stored

After login at /dashboard, verify sidebar displays with all nav links (Vue d'ensemble, Projets, Blog, Messages, Analytics, Profil, Paramètres, logout), verify header displays with breadcrumb, click logout and verify redirect to /login and token cleared from localStorage, resize to 320px width and verify sidebar collapses to hamburger icon, click hamburger and verify sidebar slides in

Navigate to Overview page, open Network tab, verify API calls to /api/projects, /api/blog, /api/messages, /api/analytics/dashboard, verify stats cards display correct numbers, verify Chart.js graphs render (line chart, bar chart, doughnut chart visible), click refresh button and verify data reloads (network requests repeat)

Navigate to Projects management, verify existing projects list displays, click 'Add Project', fill form with all fields including image file upload, verify preview image displays before submit, submit form, verify POST /api/projects in Network tab with multipart/form-data, verify new project appears in list with Cloudinary imageUrl, test drag & drop by dragging a project card and dropping in new position, verify PUT request with new order, click edit on project, modify fields, save, verify PUT request and changes reflected, click delete, confirm modal, verify DELETE request and project removed

Navigate to Blog management, click 'Add Post', type Markdown content in editor (test **bold**, # heading, - list), verify live preview pane renders HTML correctly in real-time, verify slug auto-generates from title (e.g., title 'Mon Article' → slug 'mon-article'), upload cover image, add tags, toggle published off (save as draft), submit, verify POST /api/blog in Network tab, verify new post in list with 'Draft' status badge, edit post and change published to true, verify updated in list

Submit messages via public contact form to populate inbox (at least 21 messages to test pagination), navigate to Messages inbox, verify all messages display, verify unread messages have badge/highlight, click 'Non lus' filter tab and verify only unread messages display, click mark as read on a message, verify PATCH request in Network tab and status updates immediately (no page refresh needed), verify pagination displays and works, click delete, confirm, verify DELETE request and message removed, check sidebar 'Messages' link for unread count badge matching actual unread count

Navigate to Analytics page, verify line chart displays with visits data, click date range selector and change to 'Last 7 days', verify GET /api/analytics/dashboard request with date params in Network tab, verify chart updates, verify bar chart and pie chart display, verify stats cards show totals, test with empty analytics data (delete analytics documents in DB) and verify 'No data' message displays

Navigate to Profile page, verify user info displays (username, email, role), navigate to change password section, fill form with wrong old password, submit, verify error message, fill form with correct old password and new password (matching confirmation), submit, verify POST /api/auth/change-password in Network tab, verify success message, logout, login with NEW password and verify success (confirms password actually changed)

Navigate to Settings page, click theme toggle switch, verify body class changes (e.g., 'dark-mode' added), verify visual theme changes (colors inverted), refresh page and verify theme persists (localStorage preference loaded), toggle back and verify switches to light mode

Test routing: navigate to / and verify public portfolio loads, navigate to /login and verify login page loads, without logging in try to access /dashboard/projects and verify redirect to /login, login and verify redirect to /dashboard, manually navigate to /dashboard/projects, /dashboard/blog, /dashboard/messages, /dashboard/analytics, /dashboard/profile, /dashboard/settings and verify each page loads correctly

Test responsive dashboard: open DevTools responsive mode, set to 320px width (iPhone SE), navigate through all dashboard pages (Overview, Projects, Blog, Messages, Analytics, Profile, Settings), verify sidebar hamburger works, verify all pages are usable and layouts adapt (tables become cards or scroll, forms stack fields, charts resize), repeat at 768px (iPad) and 1024px (desktop) widths, verify no horizontal scroll or broken layouts
